pairs.difference: A (beach ball): high key, sand is one broad light-to-middle group. The ball's dark green and blue panels are soft and roll off into the sand shadow. B (pier): water and both posts break into many hard dark accents. The rope coils on the left post alternate white and dark at every turn, and the posts below the deck drop almost to black where they meet the water. The dark accents are scattered rather than grouped, as on the generated lesson cards.
pairs.fix: Keep the pier posts and water in one gentle middle tone. Make the rope a soft light band without a dark gap between each coil. Use only one small dark shadow under the deck.

pairs.difference: A (ring box): the red box shell turns into a large near-black frame around the whole lower and left edge. The corners of the sunburst background go dark, and the vignette is 0.162, above the real range. B (pocket watch): light key, a white face on a mid-tone green checker, with only a thin dark rim. That matches the real cards.
pairs.fix: Paint the red box a medium red, light on the lid and front and only slightly darker on the sides. No black edges. Keep the background rays an even bright cyan out to the corners.

pairs.difference: A (hat box): the red and navy cylinder reads as one dark mass against a soft glow in a green field, a value plan like the real camera card. B (sneakers): the card is split by a hard horizontal line between an orange wall and a pale floor that is almost white. Overall key is 0.762, brighter than the real range. Inside the shoes, the white soles against dark blue mesh give hard, busy local contrast.
pairs.fix: Darken the floor to a warm middle yellow and blend it into the wall with no sharp horizon line. Make the shoe uppers an even medium blue with soft shading, not dark mesh spots.

pairs.difference: A (pearl bracelet): low key. The navy velvet is nearly black across the whole card, with bright white pearls on top. Mean lightness is 0.395 against a real minimum of 0.55, and the lightness gap is 0.497. This is tenebrist lighting the real cards never use. B (map and magnifier): a mid-light card. The light paper sits on mid-tone wood, and the darkest spot is the small magnifier handle.
pairs.fix: Put the pearls on a bright, saturated light-blue cushion, with soft mid-blue folds and no near-black areas, so the whole card stays light.

pairs.difference: A (cake stand): the card is cut in half. A near-black purple striped wall fills the top, and a white tablecloth fills the bottom. Contrast (0.224) and lightness gap (0.208) are both above the real range, and the corners are brighter than the centre (vignette -0.095). B (fountain): even warm yellow stripes and a mid-tone paved floor, with a small range of values.
pairs.fix: Make the back wall a light lilac with soft stripes, close in brightness to the tablecloth, so the stand sits in one light, even field.

pairs.difference: A (scarf): the red cloth is one dark mass with soft folds, set against a light swirl glow behind it. B (folding fan): the pleats alternate hard between near-black and middle grey across the whole fan, like the striped, high-local-contrast heroes in the generated lessons. The background waves are flat with no glow behind the fan.
pairs.fix: Shade the fan pleats softly so neighbouring folds differ only slightly. Add a gentle light glow in the background behind the fan.

pairs.difference: A (scroll): the deep navy backdrop goes nearly black over the top half, and a bright cream scroll sits on it. Lightness gap 0.313 and contrast 0.213 are both outside the real range, and the key is darker than any real card. B (DJ deck): a light orange field with a soft glow behind the hero. The darkest areas are small spots on the headphones.
pairs.fix: Use a bright sky-blue background with a light glow behind the scroll. Avoid any dark navy areas.

pairs.difference: Both heroes are dark against a cyan ring backdrop. B (top hat) is close to solid black across the crown and brim, with only thin hard sheen streaks. Its contrast (0.225) and lightness gap (-0.45) are well beyond the real range. A (graduation cap) is also dark, but has a gold band and tassel that break up the mass, and its numbers are close to the real range.
pairs.fix: Paint the top hat a dark charcoal-blue with a broad, soft lighter sheen on the crown and brim, not pure black, so it keeps a middle tone.

pairs.difference: A (trunk): a dark hero on mid-grey flagstones under blue rays. The value groups are clear, though the stone has gritty texture. B (suitcase): the yellow ray background is almost pure white, and the wall-to-floor band is very light. The card key is 0.792, above the real range. The orange case is a mid-dark block on a field that is almost all light.
pairs.fix: Deepen the background rays to a rich warm yellow-orange with visible darker rays, so the card is less bleached around the suitcase.

pairs.difference: A (vending machine): a dark blue body around a bright glass panel, on a purple field with a soft glow. B (teacup): the cup body is nearly black and broken by thin, hard white rims at the lip and saucer. The steam is a bright patch above. Both sets of numbers are in range, so the evidence is weak.
pairs.fix: Shade the cup a medium cobalt with a soft light side, rather than near-black with sharp white edges.

pairs.difference: A (fan): a purple fan with pleats of alternating value on a yellow wave field with a soft glow. B (parasol): the key is 0.805, above the real range. The white lace trim is a bright, high-contrast ring against the dark purple canopy, and a near-black wedge sits on the right panel. The harlequin background adds even more hard light-dark switching.
pairs.fix: Soften the lace to a cream tone and the canopy to a medium purple with no black panel. Make the background diamonds very subtle.

pairs.difference: A (guitar): a dark stage top with spotlight beams, but the floor and the hero form readable middle and light groups. Its numbers are near the edges of the real range. B (piano): a very dark mahogany piano sits against a near-white wallpaper wall and a light floor. Lightness gap -0.334 and contrast 0.223 are both beyond the real range. The piano is one near-black block with hard white keys.
pairs.fix: Paint the piano a warm medium red-brown with a lighter front and lid. Make the wallpaper a soft mid-cream so the piano is not a dark cut-out.

pattern: Generated cards push value to the extremes. Some heroes are near-black (top hat, piano, teacup, red box) or sit on near-black backgrounds (navy velvet, navy scroll backdrop, purple wall). Others sit on bleached near-white fields. Lightness gaps and contrast land outside the real range. Generated heroes also break into many hard light/dark switches, such as pleats, rope coils and lace rims, where real cards keep one broad middle group with soft roll-off and a gentle glow behind the hero.
